title: Windsurf vs GitHub Copilot: The Complete 2026 Comparison
summary: Windsurf has the most generous free tier in AI coding. Copilot has the deepest GitHub integration. Here's the honest comparison — and what to use for full-stack apps.
body_markdown: Yes — they complement each other. Use Windsurf (or Cursor or Claude Code) as your code editor for day-to-day development. Use Blink for the infrastructure layer: database, auth, hosting, and deployment. The Blink plugin installs 14 skills into your AI agent with one command:` npx skills add blink-new/blink-plugin` .
